=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text a1 "alpha"
text b1 "beta"
text a2 "Hello"
text b2 "hello"
text a3 "abc"
text b3 "abcd"
text teq " eq="
text tlt " lt="
text tgt " gt="
text tci " equal-ignoring-case="
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
fn emitb b bool to void
if b
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
end
note cmp is byte order: -1, 0 or 1; a proper prefix sorts first; ci folds ASCII case first
fn cmp a view uchar * b view uchar * ci bool to int
n = len a
if lt len b n
n = len b
end
for i ulong n
x = get a i
y = get b i
if and ci and ge x 65 le x 90
x = add x 32
end
if and ci and ge y 65 le y 90
y = add y 32
end
if lt x y
ret -1
end
if gt x y
ret 1
end
end
if lt len a len b
ret -1
end
if gt len a len b
ret 1
end
ret 0
end
fn show a view uchar * b view uchar * to void
c = cmp a b false
emit a
emit sp
emit b
emit teq
emitb eq c 0
emit tlt
emitb lt c 0
emit tgt
emitb gt c 0
emit tci
emitb eq cmp a b true 0
emit nl
end
fn main to int
show a1 b1
show a2 b2
show a3 b3
show b3 a3
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
alpha beta eq=no lt=yes gt=no equal-ignoring-case=no
Hello hello eq=no lt=yes gt=no equal-ignoring-case=yes
abc abcd eq=no lt=yes gt=no equal-ignoring-case=no
abcd abc eq=no lt=no gt=yes equal-ignoring-case=no
</pre>
